essence: 做旧奶油纸底，有细纸纹和浅折痕
青绿、暖棕、酒红的沉稳配色，深炭描边
平面或等距的技术插图
信息多但层级清楚：主图框、辅助细节框与纸面分栏；有字时再加说明框和要点框
复古蓝图感加现代的清楚

recipe.positive: Technical briefing infographic on aged cream paper with a subtle texture and light creases, like a vintage technical print. Clean 2D or isometric technical illustrations with crisp dark-charcoal outlines; a muted palette of teal for the main illustrations, warm brown for secondary elements and deep maroon for headlines and emphasis. Organized, information-rich layout with a clear visual hierarchy: bounded primary illustration panels or split/triptych sections, restrained secondary orthographic or detail panels, visible aged-paper gutters and fine construction lines. For title cards and other single-scene compositions, keep the scene within a bordered primary technical panel, add one or two smaller orthographic or detail panels of that same scene, and separate all panels with visible aged-paper gutters. Put titles and subtitles in distinct bordered callout boxes. When text is requested, add neat explanatory and key-insight boxes. Vintage blueprint feeling with modern clarity. Objects and scenes are drawn as matte, flat technical illustrations with clean outlines and simple fills, never glossy or photographic.
recipe.text_style: Headlines are dark maroon and body text near-black, set in neat labeled boxes; when both Chinese and English wording is given, pair them as bilingual callouts.

must_see: aged cream paper background with subtle texture or light creases
muted teal, warm brown and maroon palette with dark charcoal outlines
clean 2D or isometric technical illustration style
a clear hierarchy of bounded technical panels or split sections, separated by visible aged-paper gutters
neat labeled explanatory or key-insight boxes when text is requested
must_not_see: stamps or watermarks in a corner
a plain white or dark background instead of aged cream paper
when_text: neat labeled explanatory or key-insight boxes when text is requested

drifts.symptom: 讲解图自动补一堆英文说明与小字，超出给定文字
drifts.fix: text.items 写全要出现的文字；要双语就把两种语言都写进 items

drifts.symptom: 竖版标题卡退化成普通故事插画，只有外边框，没有技术分栏与有界文字框
drifts.fix: 主场景放进有界技术主框，同一场景补一两个小辅助视图，标题和副标题分别放入有界框
